$comment: Reviewed loader-parity exceptions for pnpm check:served-surface --loader-parity: keys whose owner or served operations change when the package's built root is imported over its manifest, keyed by divergence id (a qualified key, or '<key> (under <package>)' for a dependency key in a dependent's run). Each entry pins 'difference': only what one side serves and the other does not, per surface, so a change both sides make alike leaves it unchanged and a moved difference fails. Recorded at the B0 baseline. A new divergence fails; an entry whose key no longer diverges, or that no parity run checks, also fails, so the fix deletes it. Re-pin a reviewed moved difference with --loader-parity --repin (listed ids only); the pull-request Lint job fails an id the base does not hold and prints every re-pin as a required review item. The file persists, as an empty list when nothing diverges. Nothing adds entries automatically. See docs/content/standards.md, Served-surface snapshot.
